item.title: Why It Feels So Hard to Obey God Today
item.description: In a world overflowing with distractions, dedicating time to God can feel like a constant battle against oneself. This article explores practical strategies to minimize these diversions and deepen your connection with the divine, ensuring your faith remains your top priority. Discover how intentional planning, aligning your work with your faith, and seeking God's help can transform your daily life and bring you closer to Him.

item.title: 7 Prayers to Strengthen & Repair Your Relationship with Your Family
item.description: Family wounds cut deep, and pretending they don’t only makes it worse. These 7 powerful prayers will help you lay down the pain, forgive what feels unforgivable, and fight for healing in your home.

item.title: What the Book of Esther Teaches Us About the Last Days
item.description: Discover profound lessons of hope and faithfulness from the Book of Esther, revealing how God works behind the scenes even when His presence isn't immediately visible. Learn how this ancient narrative offers guidance and encouragement for navigating the uncertainties and challenges of today's world, assuring you that you are never alone.

item.title: A Prayer for God’s Grace to Start Spring Cleaning - Your Daily Prayer - February 28
item.description: Spring cleaning is not just about closets and garages. It is about facing what you have been avoiding and letting God clear the clutter from your heart.
